name: 圣光闪耀
description: 治疗7格内1个友军5点生命。
code: function executeSkill(context) { const sourcePiece = context.piece; const targetAlly = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 7, filter: 'ally' }); if (!targetAlly || targetAlly.needsTargetSelection) { return targetAlly; } const healValue = 5; const healResult = healDamage(sourcePiece, targetAlly, healValue, context.battle, context.skill.id); return { message: sourcePiece.name + '使' + targetAlly.name + '恢复' + healResult.heal + '点生命', success: true }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { const healValue = 5; return { description: '治疗7格内1个友军' + healValue + '点生命。', expectedValues: { heal: healValue } }; }
